claim.value: Equipment unreadiness must be distinguished from delayed crew collection.

provenance.rationale: The mapping explicitly requires this distinction without attributing a particular late start to either explanation.

signal_basis.value: Tests record return, cleaning completion, readiness communication, collection and start times, alongside whether lateness reproduces; the informative pattern is repeated lateness under reduction with specified further removals ending reproduction.
signal_basis.scope: Interpretation of the selected turnaround replay and its tested reductions.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans specify the recorded observations, reproduction pattern, selected replay and definition of failure.
No unresolved empirical bridge is needed for this bounded interpretive requirement.

rationale: Lateness alone does not distinguish equipment unreadiness from delayed collection. The operation records their separate timing stages, warranting the requirement to distinguish them when interpreting reproduced late starts. The claim does not assert that either explanation has been established.
uncertainty: Individual cases may remain unresolved; that does not undermine the requirement to preserve the distinction.
